sources.title: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection
sources.authors: Ryan Prescott Adams; David J. C. MacKay
sources.claim: Online Bayesian changepoint inference tracks the posterior distribution of run length, enabling sequential detection of abrupt changes in time-series generating dynamics.

sources.title: The Model Confidence Set
sources.authors: Peter R. Hansen; Asger Lunde; James M. Nason
sources.claim: Model selection uncertainty should be represented by a confidence set of superior models; uninformative data may justify retaining many models rather than forcing a single winner.

sources.title: Tests of Conditional Predictive Ability
sources.claim: Out-of-sample forecast comparison should allow predictive performance to vary conditionally with the information set and should remain meaningful under model misspecification.

sources.title: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
sources.authors: David H. Bailey; Jonathan Borwein; Marcos López de Prado; Qiji Jim Zhu
sources.claim: Investment strategy selection from many backtests is vulnerable to overfitting; combinatorially symmetric cross-validation provides a framework to estimate the probability of backtest overfitting.

sources.title: The Deflated Sharpe Ratio: Correcting for Selection Bias, Backtest Overfitting, and Non-Normality
sources.authors: David H. Bailey; Marcos López de Prado
sources.claim: Reported Sharpe ratios should be adjusted for multiple testing, selection bias and non-normal returns before research results are treated as evidence of skill.

sources.title: … and the Cross-Section of Expected Returns
sources.authors: Campbell R. Harvey; Yan Liu; Heqing Zhu
sources.claim: Multiple testing in factor discovery requires materially higher statistical hurdles than conventional single-test thresholds.

sources.title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning
sources.authors: Shihao Gu; Bryan Kelly; Dacheng Xiu
sources.claim: Nonlinear interactions can improve risk-premium prediction, with momentum, liquidity and volatility among the dominant predictor families in the studied equity cross-section.

sources.title: Characteristics are covariances: A unified model of risk and return
sources.authors: Bryan T. Kelly; Seth Pruitt; Yinan Su
sources.claim: Instrumented PCA separates characteristic-driven time-varying factor exposures from residual anomaly intercepts, helping distinguish systematic risk from purported alpha.

rules.hypothesis: Sequential regime-change alerts should remain shadow until run-length/changepoint probabilities are calibrated on an explicit historical regime series.
rules.mechanism: Regime transitions can be treated as changes in the time-series generating process.
rules.formalization_note: Governance/research discipline only. No direct trading weight.

rules.hypothesis: Do not force a single champion when evidence cannot distinguish models; maintain a surviving model set and shrink it only when comparative evidence is informative.
rules.mechanism: Model selection uncertainty is itself information.
rules.formalization_note: Governance/research discipline only. No direct trading weight.

rules.hypothesis: Compare models conditionally by asset, horizon and regime rather than relying only on unconditional average forecast performance.
rules.mechanism: Forecasting skill can vary with the information set and model misspecification.
rules.formalization_note: Governance/research discipline only. No direct trading weight.

rules.hypothesis: Estimate backtest-overfitting risk before promoting strategies selected from many alternatives; ordinary holdout evidence alone is not sufficient when the search space is large.
rules.mechanism: Strategy selection after extensive search creates selection bias.
rules.formalization_note: Governance/research discipline only. No direct trading weight.

rules.hypothesis: Rule promotion must adjust performance claims for the number of trials, non-normality and selection bias; raw Sharpe is not enough.
rules.mechanism: Backtest performance can be inflated by multiplicity and non-Gaussian returns.
rules.formalization_note: Governance/research discipline only. No direct trading weight.

rules.hypothesis: Raise evidence thresholds as the number of tested hypotheses grows and log the research search count for every promoted finding.
rules.mechanism: Multiple testing raises the false-discovery rate in return-predictor research.
rules.formalization_note: Governance/research discipline only. No direct trading weight.

rules.hypothesis: Test nonlinear interactions as challengers while keeping them shadow until they beat simpler models OOS net of costs.
rules.mechanism: Nonlinear interactions may contain predictive information missed by linear specifications.
rules.formalization_note: Governance/research discipline only. No direct trading weight.

rules.hypothesis: Before crediting a signal with alpha, test whether its return is explained by changing latent systematic exposures.
rules.mechanism: Observed characteristics may proxy for time-varying factor loadings.
rules.formalization_note: Governance/research discipline only. No direct trading weight.
